name: Equinix SN1 Salalah data centre (with Omantel)
notes: Equinix officially opened carrier-neutral data centre SN1 in Salalah (Janaif wilayat), Dhofar Governorate, on 7 November 2024 in partnership with Omantel, following their earlier Muscat facility; part of Equinix's strategy to make Salalah a global connectivity hub. Phase-two expansion adding 125 racks was greenlit in Equinix Q3 2024 results for completion by Q2 2025; total rack count and IT MW capacity not fully disclosed.

name: Ooredoo Salalah Data Centre and Submarine Cable Landing Station
notes: Ooredoo Oman launched the Tier 3-compliant Salalah Data Centre and Submarine Cable Landing Station on 17 August 2025 in Dhofar Governorate, inaugurated in the presence of the Governor of Dhofar; first facility in southern Oman combining a data centre and cable landing station in one location. Initial capacity for 125 server racks, scaling to 500 racks in phases. Facility hosts the 2Africa cable landing in Salalah (announced August 2022 among three Ooredoo data centres in Barka, Salalah and Sohar); Salalah is also a landing point for Gulf2Africa, Oman Australia Cable, India Europe Xpress and Google's Raman (Zain Omantel International local partner). IT MW capacity not disclosed.
